subject: BrightBay invoice adjustment & VAT routing clarification
messages:
From: Alice Thomson <alice.thomson@brightbay.io>
To: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Unexpected duplicate connector charges + VAT handling

Hi Priya,

We noticed BrightBay was billed twice for connector export activity in the November invoice (lines 12 and 13 appear to be duplicated). Additionally, VAT was applied on the wrong line item — we are a reverse-charge EU customer and expected 0% VAT on the service portion.

Could you help with:
- A corrected invoice (remove duplicate line)
- A goodwill/service credit for the duplicate charge (approx. EUR 4,200)
- Confirmation you’ll reissue the invoice with reverse-charge VAT routing

I can share the invoice and sample usage if helpful (attached). We’d like this resolved before our month-end close on Dec 10.
Thanks,
Alice Thomson
Head of Finance, BrightBay Analytics
alice.thomson@brightbay.io
Attachments: BB-Invoice-202511-exports.pdf, usage_breakdown_202511.csv

From: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Thomson <alice.thomson@brightbay.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicate connector charges + VAT handling

Alice — thanks for flagging this and for the attachments.

I’m looping in Marissa from Revenue Ops and Karthik from Finance so we can:
1) Validate the duplicate line and usage spike,
2) Confirm VAT treatment and request your EU VAT ID, and
3) Issue a credit memo + revised invoice before Dec 10.

Next steps from our side: Marissa will do a quick usage reconciliation; Karthik will prepare a provisional credit memo once we confirm the amount. I’ll follow up with timelines by EOD.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0192

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 08:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicate connector charges + VAT handling — usage reconciliation attached

Hi Alice / Priya — I pulled the meter and the raw export logs. Quick notes:
- There was a short replay-run on 2025-11-17 that reprocessed a subset of exports; the ingestion job duplicated ~1.9M tokens across two job ids which aligns with the duplicated line on the invoice.
- The true billable delta (after removing the replay) is ~EUR 4,160.

I’ve attached a CSV (usage_breakdown_202511.csv) and a short invoice markup.

Action items I recommend:
- Issue a service credit of EUR 4,160 (goodwill) applied to the Dec invoice or as a standalone credit memo — your preference.
- Reissue November invoice with the duplicate line removed and reverse-charge VAT applied (we need BrightBay VAT ID).

If you confirm VAT ID I’ll mark this as "ready for credit memo" and Karthik can publish the credit memo.

Attachments: usage_breakdown_202511.csv

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | RevOps Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

To: Alice Thomson <alice.thomson@brightbay.io>, priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Dec 2025 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicate connector charges + VAT handling — provisional credit memo attached

Alice / Priya,

Thank you for the details and the usage file — that reconciles with our logs. We can proceed as follows:

- We will issue a goodwill/service credit for EUR 4,160.
- We will reissue the November invoice removing the duplicate line and apply reverse-charge VAT (0%) once we have BrightBay's EU VAT ID.
- Proposed settlement: credit memo RB-CreditMemo-BB-20251207.pdf (provisional) issued on Dec 7, 2025; reissued invoice to follow same day.

Please provide:
- BrightBay VAT ID (EU VIES-valid)
- Preferred routing: apply credit to next invoice (Dec) or issue standalone refund? (we can do either; refund requires payment ops signoff and may take 5–7 business days).

I’ve attached a provisional credit memo PDF for your review and a Drive preview link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-credit-memo-preview

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
